# Third-Party Provenance and Attribution

`DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Layout` is the shared graph layout of the CanvasNet diagram packages. The package is
**derived with attribution**: to lay graphs out exactly the way Mermaid lays them out, its graph library and its layered
layout are ports of the projects listed below. Every ported item is acknowledged here, the license texts of the upstream
projects ship with the package (in its `licenses\` folder), and every source file that contains ported logic starts
with the header comment `// Portions derived from <project> (<license>); see third-party/README.md`. Ported code is
local source code, maintained and tested in this repository; no upstream package is a dependency.

This project is **not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by**, the authors of dagre, graphlib,
dagre-d3-es or lodash. The names are used only to describe the algorithms that are implemented.

## Original work

The friend-assembly interface, the abstract work meter (the consumer supplies the located failures), the diagnostics
of the tests and the tests themselves are original work of this repository. The dagre stage goldens
(`Fixtures/upstream-vectors/dagre-layouts.json` of the tests) are generated from dagre-d3-es by
`tools/visual-diff/mermaid/gen-dagre-goldens.mjs` on graphs from a seeded generator, so their inputs are original too,
and their expected values are the results of that MIT-licensed project. The dagre unit tests under `Dagre/` include
cases ported from the test files of dagre-d3-es (`*.test.js`, MIT, same copyright notices as `LICENSE-dagre.txt`). The
JavaScript key order of `ObjectKeyMap` (`Graphlib/`) follows the ECMAScript specification, and the work budget of
`LayoutWorkMeter` (`Dagre/`) is original.
